title: Leaving Money on the Table
Measuring Corruption from Household Income and Consumption Micro-Data: An International Perspective
The Long-run Effect of Air Pollution on Survival
abstract: Many environmental hazards produce health effects that take years to arise, but quasiexperimental studies typically measure outcomes and treatment over short time periods. We develop a new approach to overcome this challenge and use it to gauge the effect of exposure to air pollution on US life expectancy. Using changes in wind direction as an instrument for daily sulfur dioxide levels, we first characterize the short-run mortality effects of acute exposure during the time period 1972-1988.Exposure causes two distinct mortality patterns: a short-run mortality displacement effect, and a persistent accelerated aging effect. We then incorporate our estimates into a flexible health production model to quantify the lifelong effects of chronic air pollution exposure for a cohort born in 1972.Model calculations of the effect of chronic exposure on life expectancy are 7-8 times larger than the effect implied by simple extrapolation of our short-run empirical estimates. Ninety percent of the survival benefits accrue after the first fifty years of life, implying that most of the 1970 Clean Air Act's health benefits have yet to emerge for cohorts born after its passage.
abstract_zh: 许多环境危害所产生的健康影响需要数年才会显现，然而准实验研究通常只在较短的时间段内衡量结果和处理。我们开发了一种新方法来克服这一挑战，并利用该方法衡量空气污染暴露对美国预期寿命的影响。我们以风向变化作为每日二氧化硫水平的工具变量，首先刻画了1972至1988年间急性暴露的短期死亡效应。暴露会引发两种截然不同的死亡模式：短期的死亡提前效应（mortality displacement），以及持续性的加速衰老效应（accelerated aging）。随后，我们将估计结果纳入一个灵活的健康生产模型，以量化慢性空气污染暴露对1972年出生队列终生的影响。模型计算表明，慢性暴露对预期寿命的影响，是对我们短期实证估计结果进行简单外推所得影响的7至8倍。生存收益的90%出现在生命的前五十年之后，这意味着对于1972年《清洁空气法》通过之后出生的队列而言，该法案的大部分健康效益尚未显现。

title: A HIMARS in the Hand is Worth Two in the Bush: Measuring the Real Economic Value of U.S. Support for Ukraine
Rating Public Procurement Markets
Natural Disasters and Municipal Bonds
abstract: Climate change is increasing the frequency of natural disasters, which could make municipal bonds a riskier asset class. We study the effects of natural disasters on municipal bond returns, exploiting the repeat sales approach to overcome the challenge that municipal bonds trade extremely infrequently. We find substantial price effects that materialize gradually: returns of uninsured bonds fall slowly in the weeks following a disaster, by 0.31% on average, translating into investor losses of almost $10 billion. Source of bond revenue, bond insurance, disaster severity, federal disaster aid, and local financial conditions all affect the magnitude of the price effects.
abstract_zh: 气候变化正在增加自然灾害的频率，这可能使市政债券成为风险更高的资产类别。我们利用重复销售法研究自然灾害对市政债券收益率的影响，以克服市政债券交易极不频繁的难题。我们发现了逐步显现的显著价格效应：未投保债券的收益率在灾害发生后的数周内缓慢下降，平均下降0.31%，相当于投资者损失近100亿美元。债券收入来源、债券保险、灾害严重程度、联邦灾害援助以及地方财政状况，均会影响价格效应的大小。

title: Public School Access or Stay-at-Home Partner: Factors Mitigating the Adverse Effects of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Academic Parents
COVID-19 Disruptions Disproportionately Affect Female Academics
Environmental Applications of the Coase Theorem
Is the Supply of Charitable Donations Fixed? Evidence from Deadly Tornadoes
Modeling Users' Trust in Drought Forecasts
abstract: Forecast valuation studies play a key role in understanding the determinants of the value of weather and climate forecasts. Such understanding provides opportunities to increase the value that users can obtain from forecasts, which can in turn increase the use of forecasts. One of the most important factors that influences how users process forecast information and incorporate forecasts into their decision-making is trust in forecasts. Despite the evidence from empirical and field-based studies, modeling users’ trust in forecasts has not received much attention in the literature and is therefore the focus of our study. We propose a theoretical model of trust in information, built into a forecast valuation framework, to better understand 1) the role of trust in users’ processing of drought forecast information and 2) the dynamic process of users’ trust formation and evolution. Using a numerical experiment, we show that considering the dynamic nature of trust is critical in more realistic assessment of forecast value. We find that users may not perceive a potentially valuable forecast as such until they trust it enough, implying that exposure to even highly accurate forecasts may not immediately translate into forecast use. Ignoring this dynamic aspect could overestimate the economic gains from forecasts. Furthermore, the model offers hypotheses with regard to targeting strategies that can be tested with empirical and field-based studies and used to guide policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 预测价值评估研究在理解天气和气候预测价值的决定因素方面发挥着关键作用。这种理解为提高用户从预测中获得的价值提供了机会，进而可以增加预测的使用。影响用户如何处理预测信息并将其纳入决策的最重要因素之一，是对预测的信任。尽管已有实证和实地研究的证据，但对用户信任预测进行建模在文献中并未受到太多关注，因此这正是本研究的重点。我们提出了一个信息信任的理论模型，并将其纳入预测价值评估框架，以更好地理解1）信任在用户处理干旱预测信息中的作用，以及2）用户信任形成与演化的动态过程。通过数值实验，我们表明，考虑信任的动态性质对于更为现实地评估预测价值至关重要。我们发现，用户可能不会将一个潜在有价值的预测视为有价值，直到他们对其产生足够的信任，这意味着即使接触到高度准确的预测，也未必会立即转化为预测的使用。忽视这一动态方面可能会高估预测带来的经济收益。此外，该模型提出了关于定向策略的假设，这些假设可以通过实证和实地研究加以检验，并可用于指导政策干预。

title: The Causal Effects of Place on Health and Longevity
Does When You Die Depend on Where You Live? Evidence from Hurricane Katrina
abstract: We follow Medicare cohorts to estimate Hurricane Katrina's long-run mortality effects on victims initially living in New Orleans. Including the initial shock, the hurricane improved eight-year survival by 2.07 percentage points. Migration to lower-mortality regions explains most of this survival increase. Those migrating to low-versus high-mortality regions look similar at baseline, but their subsequent mortality is 0.83-1.01percentage points lower per percentage-point reduction in local mortality, quantifying causal effects of place on mortality among this population. Migrants' mortality is also lower in destinations with healthier behaviors and higher incomes but is unrelated to local medical spending and quality.
abstract_zh: 我们追踪医疗保险队列，估计飓风卡特里娜（Hurricane Katrina）对最初居住在新奥尔良的受害者的长期死亡效应。计入最初的冲击后，飓风使其八年生存率提高了2.07个百分点。迁移至死亡率较低地区解释了这一生存率提高的大部分。迁往低死亡率地区与迁往高死亡率地区的人群在基线上看起来相似，但其后续死亡率在当地死亡率每降低一个百分点的情况下分别低0.83至1.01个百分点，这量化了地点对该人群死亡率的因果效应。迁移者的死亡率在行为更健康、收入更高的目的地也较低，但与当地医疗支出和医疗质量无关。

title: Geographic and Socioeconomic Heterogeneity in the Benefits of Reducing Air Pollution in the United States
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Policies aimed at reducing the harmful effects of air pollution exposure typically focus on areas with high levels of pollution. However, if a population's vulnerability to air pollution is imperfectly correlated with current pollution levels, then this approach to air quality regulation may not efficiently target pollution reduction efforts. We examine the geographic and socioeconomic determinants of vulnerability to dying from acute exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5)pollution. We find that there is substantial local and regional variability in the share of individuals who are vulnerable to pollution both at the county and ZIP code level. Vulnerability tends to be negatively related to health and socioeconomic status. Surprisingly, we find that vulnerability is also negatively related to an area's average PM2.5 pollution level, suggesting that basing air quality regulation only on current pollution levels may fail to effectively target regions with the most to gain by reducing exposure.
abstract_zh: 旨在减少空气污染暴露有害影响的政策通常聚焦于污染水平较高的地区。然而，如果人口对空气污染的脆弱性与当前污染水平仅不完全相关，那么这种空气质量监管方法可能无法有效地针对污染削减努力。我们考察了因急性细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染暴露而死亡的脆弱性的地理和社会经济决定因素。我们发现，无论在县还是邮政编码（ZIP code）层面，因污染而脆弱的人口比例在地方和区域层面都存在显著差异。脆弱性往往与健康状况和社会经济地位呈负相关。令人惊讶的是，我们还发现，脆弱性与一个地区的平均PM2.5污染水平呈负相关，这表明仅根据当前污染水平来制定空气质量监管，可能无法有效地针对那些通过减少暴露最能获益的地区。

title: The Long-Run Dynamics of Electricity Demand: Evidence from Municipal Aggregation
abstract: We study the dynamics of residential electricity demand by exploiting a natural experiment that produced large and long-lasting price changes in over 250 Illinois communities. Using a flexible difference-in-differences matching approach, we estimate that the price elasticity of demand grows from -0:09 in the first six months to -0:27 two years later. We also estimate a more sophisticated model in which usage is a function of past and future prices, and we find similar elasticity patterns. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for consumption dynamics when evaluating energy policy.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一次自然实验研究居民用电需求的动态变化，该实验在伊利诺伊州250多个社区中造成了大幅且持久的价格变化。采用灵活的双重差分匹配方法，我们估计需求的价格弹性从最初六个月的-0:09增长到两年后的-0:27。我们还估计了一个更复杂的模型，其中用电量是过去和未来价格的函数，结果发现类似的弹性模式。我们的发现凸显了在评估能源政策时考虑消费动态的重要性。

title: Natural Disasters and Elective Medical Services: How Big is the Bounce-Back?
abstract: COVID-19 has created a dual set of stresses on health care systems worldwide: a rise in expensive intensive care services and a dramatic decline in elective services. The U.S. government has responded with both grant and loan programs to help health care providers weather the storm. But the optimal size and nature of such programs are hard to evaluate without an understanding of the ability of providers to make up their lost elective service revenues over time. In this paper, we study the closest relevant parallel to the reduction in elective services seen under COVID-19: hurricanes. We match information on hurricanes to data on Medicare hospital elective visits and charges from 1997-2013, comparing counties impacted by hurricanes to nearby unaffected counties. We find that the average hurricane reduces elective services by about 7% in the month it makes landfall. For the most severe hurricanes, we estimate a reduction of more than 20%.Services return to baseline fairly rapidly, but for severe hurricanes it takes a year or more to make up lost revenues. Projections based on variation in hurricane severity suggest that it will take over 3 years for providers to make up the lost revenue from COVID-19.
abstract_zh: COVID-19给全球医疗卫生系统带来了双重压力：重症监护服务费用激增，而择期服务则急剧下降。美国政府已通过拨款和贷款计划予以应对，以帮助医疗服务提供者渡过难关。但是，如果不了解医疗服务提供者随时间弥补损失的择期服务收入的能力，就难以评估此类计划的最优规模和性质。在本文中，我们研究了与COVID-19下择期服务减少最接近的历史类比：飓风。我们将飓风信息与1997至2013年的医疗保险（Medicare）医院择期就诊和收费数据相匹配，比较了受飓风影响的县与邻近未受影响的县。我们发现，平均而言，飓风在登陆当月使择期服务减少约7%。对于最严重的飓风，我们估计减少幅度超过20%。服务大致较快地恢复到基线水平，但对于严重的飓风，需要一年或更长时间才能弥补损失的收入。基于飓风严重程度变化的预测表明，医疗服务提供者需要超过3年时间才能弥补COVID-19造成的收入损失。

title: The Distributional Consequences of Building Energy Codes
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: The Mortality and Medical Costs of Air Pollution: Evidence from Changes in Wind Direction
abstract: We estimate the causal effects of acute fine particulate matter exposure on mortality, health care use, and medical costs among the US elderly using Medicare data and a novel instrument for air pollution: changes in local wind direction. We develop a new approach that uses machine learning to estimate the life-years lost due to pollution exposure and show that our procedure reduces bias relative to previous methods. Finally, we characterize treatment effect heterogeneity using both life expectancy and generic machine learning inference. Both approaches find that mortality effects are concentrated in about 25 percent of the elderly population.
abstract_zh: 我们利用医疗保险数据以及一个新颖的空气污染工具变量（当地风向变化），估计了急性细颗粒物暴露对美国老年人死亡率、医疗服务使用和医疗费用的因果效应。我们开发了一种新方法，利用机器学习估计污染暴露造成的预期寿命损失，并表明该程序相较于以往方法降低了偏误。最后，我们利用预期寿命和通用机器学习推断，刻画了处理效应的异质性。两种方法均发现，死亡效应集中在约25%的老年人口中。

title: Does the Samaritan's Dilemma Matter? Evidence from U.S. Agriculture
abstract: The Samaritan's dilemma posits a downside to charity: recipients may rely on free aid instead of their own efforts. Anecdotally, the expectation of free assistance is thought to be important for decisions about insurance and risky behavior in numerous settings, but reliable empirical evidence is scarce. We estimate whether the Samaritan's dilemma exists in U.S. agriculture, where both private crop insurance and frequent federal disaster assistance are present. We find that bailout expectations are qualitatively and quantitatively important for the insurance decision. Furthermore, aid expectations reduce both expenditure on farm inputs and subsequent crop revenue.
abstract_zh: “撒玛利亚人困境”（Samaritan’s dilemma）揭示了慈善的一个负面影响：受助者可能依赖免费援助，而不是依靠自身努力。据观察，人们对免费援助的预期被认为对许多情境下的保险和风险行为决策具有重要影响，但可靠的实证证据却很少。我们估计了撒玛利亚人困境在美国农业中是否存在，因为美国农业中既有私人农作物保险，又频繁存在联邦灾害援助。我们发现，救助预期对保险决策在定性和定量上都具有重要影响。此外，援助预期还会减少农业投入品的支出以及随后的作物收入。

title: The Economic Impact of Hurricane Katrina on Its Victims: Evidence from Individual Tax Returns
abstract: Hurricane Katrina destroyed more than 200,000 homes and led to massive economic and physical dislocation. Using a panel of tax return data, we provide one of the first comprehensive analyses of the hurricane's long-term economic impact on its victims. Katrina had large and persistent impacts on where people live; small and mostly transitory impacts on wage income, employment, total income, and marriage; and no impact on divorce or fertility. Within just a few years, Katrina victims' incomes fully recover and even surpass that of controls from similar cities that were unaffected by the storm. The strong economic performance of Katrina victims is particularly remarkable given that the hurricane struck with essentially no warning. Our results suggest that, at least in this particular disaster, aid to cover destroyed assets and short-run income declines was sufficient to make victims financially whole. Our results provide some optimism regarding the costs of climate-change driven dislocation, especially when adverse events can be anticipated well in advance.
abstract_zh: 飓风卡特里娜摧毁了超过20万座房屋，并导致了大规模的经济和人员流离失所。利用个人纳税申报数据面板，我们对该飓风对受害者的长期经济影响进行了较为全面的分析，这是最早的此类分析之一。卡特里娜对人们的居住地产生了较大且持久的影响；对工资收入、就业、总收入和婚姻的影响较小且大多是暂时的；对离婚和生育则没有影响。在短短几年内，卡特里娜受害者的收入就完全恢复，甚至超过了未受该风暴影响的类似城市对照组。鉴于飓风在几乎没有任何预警的情况下来袭，卡特里娜受害者出色的经济表现尤为引人注目。我们的结果表明，至少在这一特定灾害中，用于弥补被毁资产和短期收入下降的援助，足以使受害者在经济上得到全面补偿。我们的结果为气候变化驱动的流离失所成本提供了一些乐观的依据，尤其是在不利事件能够提前充分预期的情况下。

title: Firm-Level Financial Resources and Environmental Spills
abstract: Using novel US environmental spill data, we document a robust negative relationship between the number of spills a firm experiences in a given year and its contemporaneous and lagged (but not future) cash flow. In addition, studying two natural experiments, we find an increase (decrease) in spills following negative (positive) shocks to a firm's financial resources, relative to control firms. Overall, our results suggest that firms' financial resources play an important role in their ability to mitigate environmental risk and that such resources therefore affect communities in which these firms operate.
abstract_zh: 利用美国新的环境泄漏数据，我们记录了一个稳健的负相关关系：某企业在某一年发生的泄漏次数，与其同期以及滞后（但与未来无关）的现金流之间存在负相关。此外，通过考察两个自然实验，我们发现，相对于对照企业，企业财务资源受到负面（正面）冲击后，泄漏次数会增加（减少）。总体而言，我们的结果表明，企业的财务资源在其减轻环境风险的能力中发挥着重要作用，因此这些资源会影响企业所在的社区。

title: Impacts of Crop Insurance on Water Withdrawals for Irrigation
The Fiscal Cost of Hurricanes: Disaster Aid Versus Social Insurance
abstract: Little is known about the fiscal costs of natural disasters, especially regarding social safety nets that do not specifically target extreme weather events. This paper shows that US hurricanes lead to substantial increases in non-disaster government transfers, such as unemployment insurance and public medical payments, in affected counties in the decade after a hurricane. The present value of this increase significantly exceeds that of direct disaster aid. This implies, among other things, that the fiscal costs of natural disasters have been significantly underestimated and that victims in developed countries are better insured against them than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 人们对自然灾害的财政成本知之甚少，尤其是那些并非专门针对极端天气事件的社会安全网的成本。本文表明，美国飓风会在飓风过后的十年内，使受灾县的非灾害性政府转移支付（例如失业保险和公共医疗支付）显著增加。这一增加额的现值显著超过了直接的灾害援助。这意味着，除其他方面外，自然灾害的财政成本被显著低估了，并且发达国家的受灾者所获得的保险保障也比以往认为的更为充分。

title: The Marginal Product of Climate
abstract: We develop an empirical approach to value changes to a climate in terms of total market output given optimal factor allocations in general equilibrium. Our approach accounts for unobservable heterogeneity across locations as well as the costs and benefits of adaptation in climates of arbitrary dimension. Importantly, we demonstrate that the Envelope Theorem implies the marginal product of a long-run climate can be exactly identified using only idiosyncratic weather variation. We apply this method to the temperature climate of the modern United States and find that, despite evidence that populations adapt, the marginal product of temperature has remained unchanged during 1970-2010, with high temperatures having low net value. Integrating marginal products recovers a value function for temperature, describing the causal effect of non-marginal climate changes net of adaptive re-optimization. We use this value function to consider the influence of temperature in the current cross-section and a future climate change scenario.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种实证方法，用以在一般均衡中，依据最优要素配置，以总市场产出来衡量气候变化的价值。我们的方法考虑了各地点不可观测的异质性，以及任意维度气候条件下适应的成本与收益。重要的是，我们证明，包络定理意味着，仅利用特质性天气变异，即可精确识别长期气候的边际产出。我们将该方法应用于现代美国的温度气候，发现尽管有证据表明人口会适应，但在1970至2010年间，温度的边际产出却保持不变，高温的净价值较低。对边际产出进行积分，可以恢复温度的价值函数，该函数描述了扣除适应性再优化之后，非边际性气候变化的因果效应。我们利用该价值函数来考察当前横截面上温度的影响，以及未来气候变化情景下的影响。

title: The Effect of Information Provision on Public Consensus About Climate Change
abstract: Despite over 20 years of research and scientific consensus on the topic, climate change continues to be a politically polarizing issue. We conducted a survey experiment to test whether providing the public with information on the exact extent of scientific agreement about the occurrence and causes of climate change affects respondents' own beliefs and bridges the divide between conservatives and liberals. First, we show that the public significantly underestimated the extent of the scientific consensus. We then find that those given concrete information about scientists' views were more likely to report believing that climate change was already underway and that it was caused by humans. However, their beliefs about the necessity of making policy decisions and their willingness to donate money to combat climate change were not affected. Information provision affected liberals, moderates, and conservatives similarly, implying that the gap in beliefs between liberals and conservatives is not likely to be bridged by information treatments similar to the one we study. Finally, we conducted a 6-month follow-up with respondents to see if the treatment effect persisted; the results were statistically inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于这一主题已有二十多年的研究，并且科学界已形成共识，但气候变化仍然是一个在政治上存在严重分歧的议题。我们开展了一项调查实验，以检验向公众提供有关气候变化发生和成因的科学共识确切程度的信息，是否会影响受访者自身的信念，并弥合保守派与自由派之间的分歧。首先，我们发现公众显著低估了科学共识的程度。随后，我们发现，那些获得了关于科学家观点具体信息的受访者，更有可能表示相信气候变化已经发生，并且是由人类造成的。然而，他们关于有必要做出政策决定的信念以及为应对气候变化捐款的意愿并未受到影响。信息提供对自由派、温和派和保守派的影响相似，这意味着自由派与保守派之间的信念差距，不太可能通过类似于我们所研究的这种信息处理手段得到弥合。最后，我们对受访者进行了为期6个月的追踪调查，以检验处理效应是否持续存在；结果在统计上并不确定。

title: Does Beauty Matter in Undergraduate Education?
Now You See It, Now You Don't: The Vanishing Beauty Premium

title: How Do People Update? The Effects of Local Weather Fluctuations on Beliefs About Global Warming
